name: DSH Market
description: dsh 里的可视化插件市场：浏览、搜索、一键安装社区插件。装了它之后，后续找插件就不用再回到这个面板。
descriptionEn: A visual plugin market inside dsh: browse, search, and install community plugins in one click. With it installed, finding the next plugin no longer means coming back to this panel.

name: DSH Better Sidebar
description: 类似 VSCode 的右侧边栏（文件树 / 编辑器 / 终端 / git / 浏览器），按会话隔离，并对外提供注册侧边栏页签与文件预览的接口。
descriptionEn: A VSCode-like right sidebar (explorer, editor, terminal, git, browser), isolated per session, exposing a service other plugins can register tabs and file viewers with.

name: Web Search Free
description: 免费的联网搜索与网页抓取通道：Tavily / Exa / Jina / Firecrawl / Brave 多引擎按序 fallback，可拖动排序、每个引擎填多个 Key。走各家专用检索接口，不经过任何模型，因此一次搜索 0 模型 token，也不需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。
descriptionEn: A free web search and fetch channel: Tavily, Exa, Jina, Firecrawl and Brave chained with automatic fallback, reorderable by drag, several keys per engine. It calls each engine's own search endpoint rather than a model, so a search costs zero model tokens and needs no DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

name: Vendor Login
description: 用你自己的订阅账号登录那些根本不发 API Key 的 AI 编程套餐：Claude Pro/Max/Team、ChatGPT Plus/Pro、GitHub Copilot、SuperGrok。在 dsh 设置界面里直接走各家官方的 OAuth / 设备码流程，令牌只留在本机。
descriptionEn: Sign in to AI coding plans that hand out no API key at all — Claude Pro/Max/Team, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, GitHub Copilot, SuperGrok — with your own subscription, straight from dsh's settings UI. It drives each vendor's own OAuth or device-code flow and the tokens stay on your machine.
